Name: Growable Ores
Author: ChillsEmporium
Description:
[b]Growable Ores – Stardew Valley Mod[/b][b]Overview[/b][b]Growable Ores[/b] lets you [b]grow any ore[/b] in [i]Stardew Valley[/i] as a crop!
You can purchase ore seeds directly from [b]Pierre’s General Store[/b]. Each ore crop takes [b]12 days to grow[/b], and once matured, it will produce additional ore every [b]3 days[/b].
This mod is designed to add an alternative, renewable method of obtaining ores, especially useful for players who enjoy farming-focused gameplay.
[line][b]Planned Features[/b][list]
[*]Add support for [b]JojaMart[/b] in late-game progression (to be implemented if not automatic).
[*]Additional balance and visual updates as needed.
[/list][line][b]Installation Instructions[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Extract the Mod File[/b]
Use a tool like [b]7-Zip[/b] to extract the downloaded archive.

[*][b]Move to the Mods Folder[/b]
Place the folder named [b]Growable Ores[/b] into your Stardew Valley Mods directory:
[code]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]

[*][b]Install Required Dependencies[/b]
This mod requires the following to function properly:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] – Required mod loader for Stardew Valley
[*]content patcher
[/list][/list][b]
[/b][list=1]
[b]To install:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download and extract [b]Json Assets[/b] and [b]SpaceCore[/b].
[*]Move both folders to your [code]Mods[/code] directory (just like with Growable Ores).
[*]For [b]SMAPI[/b], extract the archive and run the installer that matches your game version.
[/list]A [b]video tutorial[/b] will be available soon to help with installation.

[/list][line][b]Uninstallation[/b]To uninstall the mod, simply delete the [b]Growable Ores[/b] folder from your [code]Mods[/code] directory.
[line][b]Bug Reports & Balancing[/b]If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements, please contact me.
Community feedback is greatly appreciated!

Downloads.Description: I have upgraded the mod to content patcher and rebalanced to price based on the normal game, also made the seed bag artwork better
